steps.en: Revive request is sent straight after the officer confirms
steps.id: Request revive langsung dikirim setelah officer konfirmasi

steps.en: Request is checked: reason, officer, remarks length, notice status
steps.id: Request dicek: reason, officer, panjang remarks, status notice

steps.en: All active suspensions of the notice are marked as revived
steps.id: Semua suspension aktif notice ditandai sudah di-revive

steps.en: Notice record is cleared of suspension or refilled from the remaining one
steps.id: Data notice dibersihkan dari suspension atau diisi dari yang tersisa

steps.en: Public-facing notice copy is updated too
steps.id: Salinan notice untuk eService ikut diperbarui
steps.why_en: If updating the public copy fails, it is only logged and the officer still sees success.
steps.why_id: Kalau update salinan untuk eService gagal, hanya di-log dan officer tetap melihat sukses.

steps.en: For a reduction revival the amount is restored to the pre-reduction value
steps.id: Pada revival reduction, amount dikembalikan ke nilai sebelum reduction
steps.why_en: The restore is best-effort and skipped without error when no reduction record is found.
steps.why_id: Pengembalian amount hanya best-effort dan dilewati tanpa error kalau record reduction tidak ada.
